result.document_summary: A mis-scraped page of San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 4 (well permits and stormwater management and discharge control) that does not contain the algorithmic rent-pricing section its URL suggests.
result.notes: This part of the document contains only San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 4 text on well permits (§§ 43.0215-43.0219) and stormwater/illicit discharge rules (§§ 43.0301-43.0308). Although the URL points to Division 11 (prohibition of anti-competitive automated rent price fixing, § 98.1103), none of that text appears in this part, so no rule in the six rental-housing categories can be extracted and the list is empty.
